purpose: Deterministic Mac-local / Hetzner-remote execution package. Rail A completed all source-side work reachable from a cloud Linux environment; Rail B generates the release-scope inputs that can only be produced on the Mac (exact images, production-shaped data, complete browser journeys) and then deploys.
railANote: Rail A changed no runtime source. All Rail A commits are tests, release tooling, inventory and evidence, so the executable candidate is unchanged from the operator-verified Mac baseline.

verifier.note: An attachment or ~/Downloads copy is NOT release authority.

requires: remote annotated tag at package head

validation.dryRun: PASS — host attestation correctly reported this non-Darwin host as FAIL; unexecuted steps report NOT-RUN(dry-run), never PASS
validation.prohibitionAudit: performed on executable lines with comments stripped: 0 compose-down, 0 reboot, 0 infra restart, 0 marker write, 0 wildcard removal
validation.evidenceLocation: written outside the Git root (sibling of the outer repo), so gate runs never dirty the worktree
validation.evidencePathSafety: rejects paths inside the Git root, inside .git, inside GoldPlusFinal, and symlinks into any of them; resolves physically before deciding
validation.dryRunTruthfulness: 0 PASS lines in dry-run output; every unexecuted step records NOT_RUN

preapprovalGates: clean worktree with --untracked-files=all and origin alignment
Docker Desktop readiness (open -a Docker, up to 3 minutes)
exact clean-source API and web image builds from git archive at the executable commit
build-context proof: no node_modules or dist leakage
exact-image API canary: /health, /health/live, /health/ready, /products, collection at data
exact-image web canary against the exact API image, no restart loop
read-only production-shaped backup through ssh goldplus-prod (pg_dump -Fc, mode 600, credentials never echoed)
backup SHA-256 and pg_restore table-of-contents listing
isolated restore into a throwaway PostgreSQL container
populated migration rehearsal, then an idempotent second run
old-runtime image identity capture and new-runtime restored-data canary
complete Playwright journeys on both chromium projects
clean-tree gates: secret scan, typecheck, build, test, architecture, lint, diff check
module coverage validation and canonical scope verification
operator-script syntax, dry-run and refusal tests
productionOrder: baseline capture and exact rollback-image preservation
database backup and isolated restore rehearsal

lintBaseline.source: parsed from pnpm lint output by scripts/release/claude/reconcile-lint.mjs

releaseFreeze.reason: Exact image identities, restored production-shaped data and complete Playwright results are release-scope inputs and can only be generated on the Mac. Freezing in Rail A would produce another candidate with unrun gates.

branchSemantics.WORKTREE_BRANCH: local branch name; evidence only — never required to equal TARGET_BRANCH
branchSemantics.TARGET_BRANCH: remote branch defining the baseline and receiving the package (default phase-2-measurement-control-tower-completion, override with --target-branch or RAIL_B_TARGET_BRANCH)
branchSemantics.EXPECTED_REMOTE_HEAD: origin/TARGET_BRANCH at run start; re-checked before finalisation
branchSemantics.acceptedCase: clean side branch whose HEAD equals origin/TARGET_BRANCH

rules.NOT_RUN: deliberately skipped, including every dry-run step

playwrightClassification.railADetail: 14/14 journeys, chromium desktop + mobile, live API catalogue resolver, 11 resolver tests, compiled services (not exact images)
playwrightClassification.note: The final release scope must bind the Mac exact-image evidence, never substitute the Rail A subset.

externalVerifier.name: GoldPlus_Mac_Rail_B_Final_Verifier.sh
externalVerifier.location: must live OUTSIDE the worktree (e.g. ~/Downloads); it refuses to run from inside the Git root
externalVerifier.portability: POSIX tools only — no GNU-specific awk/grep/sed, so BSD userland on macOS behaves identically

modes.default: verification only; starts no preapproval work and mutates nothing
modes.--execute: verification then the tracked real preapproval

releaseFinalisation.note: The tracked preapproval script does NOT compute a final scope or create an annotated tag. It validates and stops. Final scope and tag creation remain a separate, explicitly authorised step once the Mac evidence exists.

architecture.trackedVerifier: verifies the worktree and Rail B package; runs no validation, freezes nothing
architecture.preapprovalValidator: executes every mandatory gate; produces immutable validation evidence only
architecture.releaseFinaliser: consumes one successful validation run; builds the final scope, package head and remote annotated tag
architecture.productionExecutor: accepts only a finalised, remotely tagged release plus the exact human marker

gateStateMachine.terminalRule: The earliest mandatory FAIL or BLOCKED is authoritative: persist evidence atomically, run cleanup, exit non-zero. No later phase, adapter, PASS record, SSH or Docker work, and no finalisation.
gateStateMachine.notRun: allowed only in explicit dry-run or as a post-terminal record; never satisfies a mandatory gate
gateStateMachine.notApplicable: allowed only for a genuinely optional gate and requires a recorded reason

dockerReadiness.neverRuns: docker context use — the operator global context is never changed

correctMacSequence: fast-forward the clean Mac side worktree
shadow canary, backup rehearsal, API-first deploy, web deploy, all-module UAT, one-hour soak, reconciliation
